name: Proton Pass for Business
description_en:
Proton Pass for Business organizes an organization’s logins, passkeys, notes and other sensitive items into shareable vaults, with user administration and plan-dependent policies. It is a distinct business scope within Proton’s larger email, VPN and storage ecosystem; a Pass subscription does not automatically include the whole Workspace suite.

The main evaluation is who owns a vault, who can share its content and what happens when a person leaves. Browser and mobile autofill serve daily users, while the admin panel manages membership and authentication policy.
description_zh:
Proton Pass for Business 将组织的登录、passkey、笔记等敏感项目组织为可共享保险库，并提供用户管理及依套餐而定的策略。它属于 Proton 邮件、VPN、存储生态中的独立商业范围，Pass 订阅不自动包含整个 Workspace 套件。

评估重点是保险库归谁、谁能共享内容，以及成员离开时如何处理。浏览器及移动填充服务日常用户，管理面板负责成员与认证策略。

sections.title_en: Start with organization and vault boundaries
sections.title_zh: 先确定组织及保险库边界
sections.en:
The admin guide first enables multi-user support, authenticates the administrator and names the organization. Users can be invited by email or provisioned with a password; invited users can receive admin rights after accepting. The user guide then separates importing items, creating a vault, sharing it and installing the extension.

A pilot could place a disposable supplier login in a project vault, invite a second user and compare its access with a personal test vault. Check imported URLs, notes and custom fields against their source. A successful import does not establish that every item is in the intended sharing boundary.
sections.zh:
管理指南先启用多用户支持，验证管理员并命名组织。可邮件邀请用户或通过密码配置，受邀用户接受后可授予管理员权限。用户指南再区分导入项目、创建保险库、共享及安装扩展。

试点可将可丢弃供应商登录放入项目保险库，邀请第二人，对照其对个人测试保险库的访问。导入的网址、笔记及自定义字段需与源数据核对。导入成功不代表每个项目都处于预期共享范围。

sections.en:
The current groups guide explicitly requires a Professional organization. Administrators create groups, choose an access level and share a vault or item with the group; later members inherit its shared access. Group owners may manage membership and accept invitations for the group. Treat those roles as separate from ordinary item viewing.

The admin guide distinguishes changing a password, revoking Proton sessions and deleting an organization user. Removing vault access is another action. None by itself proves every external application session or copied credential is revoked. Validate offboarding and the account/data recovery configuration before making this the sole store of operational credentials.
sections.zh:
当前组指南明确要求 Professional 组织。管理员创建组，选择访问级别，并向组共享保险库或项目，后续成员会继承共享访问。组 owner 可管理成员并代组接受邀请，与普通查看项目是不同角色。

管理指南区分更改密码、撤销 Proton 会话和删除组织用户，移除保险库访问又是另一操作。任何单项都不能证明全部外部应用会话或已复制凭据已撤销。作为运营凭据唯一存储前，应验证离职流程及账户／数据恢复配置。

sections.title_en: Business seats and suite costs are different
sections.title_zh: 商业席位与套件费用不同
sections.en:
The business page displays Essentials at USD 1.99/user/month, billed USD 23.88, and Professional at USD 4.49, billed USD 53.88, with a three-user minimum and taxes potentially added. Workspace Standard displays USD 12.99/user/month billed USD 155.88 every twelve months. These displayed offers can change at renewal; confirm the order term.

Essentials includes vault/item/link sharing and the built-in authenticator. Professional adds SSO/SCIM, detailed logs, policies, SIEM, group sharing, CLI and SSH-agent features. For ten Professional seats the displayed annual-rate subtotal is USD 538.80 before tax. The fourteen-day business trial is not an ongoing free business tier. No software source license or hosted security posture was independently audited.
sections.zh:
商业页显示 Essentials 每用户月 1.99 美元、实收 23.88，Professional 月 4.49、实收 53.88，至少三用户，可能加税；Workspace Standard 每用户月 12.99、每十二个月实收 155.88。这些显示优惠续费时可能变化，需核订单周期。

Essentials 包含保险库／项目／链接共享及内置认证器；Professional 增加 SSO／SCIM、详细日志、策略、SIEM、组共享、CLI 和 SSH agent。十个 Professional 席位按所示年费口径税前小计 538.80 美元。十四天商业试用不等于持续免费商业版。未独立审计源码许可或托管安全状态。
